program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time }) { const u = inputs.launchSpeed; const g = inputs.gravity; const m = inputs.mass; const t = time; const v = u - g * t; const y = u * t - 0.5 * g * t * t; const a = -g; const F = m * g; const apexTime = u / g; const apexHeight = (u * u) / (2 * g); let motionState = "Rising"; if (Math.abs(v) < 0.05) { motionState = "At the top"; } else if (v < 0) { motionState = "Falling"; } if (y <= 0 && t > 0.1) { motionState = "Back at launch height"; } if (t === 0) { motionState = "Ready to toss"; } const maxT = (2 * u) / g; const pointsCount = 20; const vtPoints = []; for (let i = 0; i <= pointsCount; i++) { const st = (i / pointsCount) * maxT; const sv = u - g * st; vtPoints.push({ x: st, y: sv }); } const currentVt = []; for (let i = 0; i <= pointsCount; i++) { const st = (i / pointsCount) * Math.min(t, maxT); const sv = u - g * st; currentVt.push({ x: st, y: sv }); } const laneLeft = sdk.panel({ x: 20, y: 40, w: 280, h: 360, title: "Motion", state: motionState }); const laneRight = sdk.panel({ x: 320, y: 40, w: 300, h: 360, title: "Velocity over time", state: "v = u - gt" }); const axisY = sdk.axis("axis.y", { x: 50, y: 350, length: 260, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, ticks: [0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0], label: "Height", unit: "m" }); const ballY = 80 + Math.max(0, Math.min(260, (y / 2.2) * 260)); const ballObj = sdk.circle("ball.toss", 150, 350 - ballY, 24, { role: "output" }); const vecV = sdk.vector("vec.v", { x: 150, y: 350 - ballY }, { value: v, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, label: "v" }); const vecA = sdk.vector("vec.a", { x: 175, y: 350 - ballY }, { value: a, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, label: "a" }); const callout = sdk.callout(195, 340 - ballY, [`v: ${v.toFixed(2)} m/s`, `a: ${a.toFixed(2)} m/s^2`, `Fg: ${F.toFixed(2)} N`], { id: "callout.toss" }); const plotVt = sdk.plot("plot.vt", { x: 340, y: 70, w: 260, h: 220, axes: { x: { label: "Time", min: 0, max: 1.8, unit: "s" }, y: { label: "Velocity", min: -5.5, max: 5.5, unit: "m/s" } }, series: [{ label: "v(t)", kind: "line", points: currentVt }] }); const note = sdk.text("plot.vt.note", 350, 310, "Slope a = -g", { role: "neutral" }); const objects = [...laneLeft, ...laneRight, axisY, ballObj, ...vecV, ...vecA, callout, plotVt, note]; return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects, readouts: [{ id: "velocity", value: v }, { id: "acceleration", value: a }, { id: "force", value: F }, { id: "motionState", value: motionState }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed: u, gravity: g, mass: m, apexTime, apexHeight, height: y, velocity: v, acceleration: a, force: F } }; }

manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero, but acceleration remains -g and gravitational force is mg.
manifest.description: A simulation of a vertical ball toss showing height, velocity vectors, acceleration, and a velocity-time graph.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. Compare readings at the top.
